questions.question: Opposite of 'ANCIENT'?
questions.hint: 💡 Ancient means very old from a long time ago. The opposite is brand new or modern!

questions.question: Synonym for 'BRAVE'?
questions.hint: 💡 A brave hero shows courage and has no fear — they are fearless!

questions.question: Which word is a NOUN?
questions.hint: 💡 A noun is a person, place, or thing. A 'Castle' is a grand building/place!

questions.question: Past tense of 'FLY'?
questions.hint: 💡 'Fly' is an irregular verb: Today birds fly, yesterday they flew!

questions.question: Which is spelled correctly?
questions.hint: 💡 Remember the spelling rule: 'I before E, except after C' → R-E-C-E-I-V-E!

questions.question: Plural of 'CHILD'?
questions.hint: 💡 'Child' has an irregular plural form: one child, many children!

questions.question: Opposite of 'EXPAND'?
questions.hint: 💡 Expand means to get bigger. The opposite is to get smaller or shrink!
